meta.title: Workbench suite
meta.description: The product install entry: base capabilities (storage, runtime, UI kit, shell, layout frame, settings page) plus the frame bridge plugin. The workbench covers the native DSH UI without taking it over; Esc or Return to DSH goes back. Data is written only under %LOCALAPPDATA%/LocalFolio. Test surfaces are not included; install @folio/test-suite separately when needed.
